description: This file implements a static class for calculating CRC32 checksums, specifically used within the PNG image processing context in the PDFsharp library. It includes methods to compute CRC32 over byte arrays, lists of bytes, and multiple byte arrays, with internal lookup table initialization for efficiency.

classes.name: Crc32
classes.description: Static class providing functionality to compute CRC32 checksums for PNG data validation.

methods.name: Calculate(byte[] data)
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum for the given byte array.

methods.name: Calculate(List<byte> data)
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum for a list of bytes.

methods.name: Calculate(byte[] data, byte[] data2)
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum for two concatenated byte arrays.
